messages:
Victor H.: Dropping the pen-test + vuln-scan bundle for Acme's vendor risk review. Package includes: pen-test-report.pdf, nessus_export.json, nmap_full.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, evidence/ (screenshots, logs, pcaps). S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_audit_1795554321.zip
SHA256: 4f6a2b9c8d3e1f0a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0987654321abcdef1234567890abcdef12

AuditBot: Scan summary: Nessus Pro + nmap 7.93. Findings: 0 CRITICAL, 6 HIGH, 14 MEDIUM, 5 LOW. remediation-tracker.csv contains CVE references, suggested mitigations, and evidence links. :mag:

Sana M.: Sales needs the tracker to include: owner, owning team, ETA (YYYY-MM-DD), change-request, on-call contact, and a redaction flag (yes/no) for screenshots. Acme also asked that any screenshots redact external IPs and that the attestation be signed by our CISO with a legal stamp. Can InfoSec do that?

Victor H.: Added the requested columns and redaction flag; full CSV updated in the zip. Sample rows pasted below (full file in bundle):
```
issue_id,short_desc,severity,owner,team,eta,change_req,oncall,redacted
A-100,Admin UI default creds,HIGH,Ibrahim O.,Platform Security,2026-05-07,CHG-9001,oncall@redwood.com,yes
A-116,TLS v1.0 enabled,MEDIUM,Infra Team,Infrastructure,2026-05-12,CHG-9002,oncall@redwood.com,yes
A-128,Missing CSP header,MEDIUM,Web Eng,Frontend,2026-05-10,CHG-9003,oncall@redwood.com,no
```

Ibrahim O.: For A-100: default admin creds found on a legacy management instance. Plan: rotate credentials, revoke sessions, remove legacy image tags. I will execute rotation during the 02:00-03:00 UTC window and validate. ETA 2026-05-07 to include post-change verification. Evidence files: A-100-creds-snap-redacted.png, A-100-authlog-snippet.txt. Verification snippets in tracker: `grep "Accepted password" /var/log/auth.log` and `curl -I https://admin.example.internal`

Sana M.: Customer requested extended retention to 180 days for legal review. AuditBot: what's current retention policy and how do we request extension?

AuditBot: Default retention for security artifacts = 90 days. To extend retention to 180 days open a ticket in #legal-retention referencing the change request (e.g., CHG-9001). :memo:

Victor H.: I'll GPG-sign the attestation and route to the CISO for signature and legal stamping. Will upload a v2 of the zip once signed. Sales intends to send to Acme on 2026-05-08 08:00 PT and will promise a 72-hour window for clarifying questions. Keeping S3 object versioned until legal confirms extended retention. Closing thread unless objections.
